issue.body:
Follow #20557, fix #21224

The `clone_script` will update `.js-clone-url` and related elements (unfortunately it's not obvious in code and fragile), so it should be put after these elements.

issue.body:
Backport #21225, fix for #21128 (also in 1.17.3), close #21224

The indent was incorrect before, so this PR did some formatting work. 

Bypass Golang's template bug for JS string interpolation. And since there are JS lint rules for templates, so the string interpolation is also a must.


[Compare with ignoring white spaces](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/21226/files?diff=unified&w=1)
